turns.content: Determine product A from 1,1-dimethoxyethan-1-amine and but-3-en-2-ol under acid and heat, and identify the acid-promoted transformation.
Determine product B from thermal rearrangement of (3R,4S)-3,4-dimethylhexa-1,5-diyne, including alkene retention and stereochemistry.
Determine product C from heating 2-((vinyloxy)methyl)but-1-ene and identify the sigmatropic rearrangement.
State the Claisen-rearrangement mapping used to assign product C from the allyl vinyl ether.
Apply that mapping under heat only and identify the unreduced aldehyde product C.
State the complete names of A, B, and C.
Explain how unspecified acid identity, water activity, concentration, and equilibration time qualify exclusivity of A without changing the idealized assignments.
Report the product set as the best-supported idealized outcome with calibrated confidence.
Check carbon skeletons, the thermal stereochemistry of B, and the absence of a reductive workup for C.
Give the final product names with the condition qualification.
